goal: Image, PDF, and Word intake extract text without a test stub when hosted OCR is configured, and mode llm uses a configured live-model extractor
scenarios: an image is OCR'd by the configured hosted recognizer without a per-test understanding stub
a PDF with no extractable text falls back to hosted OCR
a Word document still extracts without OCR
mode llm uses the configured extractor without injecting a test stub
mode llm still fails loud when no extractor is configured
an image without OCR configuration stays pending
human approval is still required before candidates become WorkItems
customers can upload attachments and run llm analysis on their own sessions
constraints: candidates are not committed WorkItems until approved
a hosted model fleet is not a product
nonGoals: hosted model fleet as a product
